name: edge-fade-scroller
title: Edge fade scroller
description: A scroll container that fades its edges only where there is more to scroll, for chip rows, menus and long lists, and never covers text.
docs: The fade is a CSS mask, so it works on any background and never covers text or catches a click. Its width follows the scroll position, so it grows as you leave an edge and is gone when nothing overflows. Scrolling stays native: keyboard, wheel and touch are untouched, and an item focused with the keyboard scrolls to a spot clear of the fade. When nothing inside is focusable, pass label to make the box a labelled region you can scroll with the keyboard; its focus ring is drawn outside the fade. onReachEnd fires once each time the end is reached, for loading the next page. Give a horizontal row a flex layout through className.
